unreleased: Add the repository module (src/modules/repository) and make the home page of HomeRepository: a visitor who is not signed in reads what the application is for, a signed-in user sees their repositories as blocks framed in their own colour (name, description, how many tables and records, an Open button) with a New repository button. A repository opens in a page tinted with its colour scheme (eight schemes, each with a light and a dark variant) with its tables as a side menu (a drop-down on phones). A repository has a name, description, a slug made from the name and checked while you type, and a colour scheme, and can be edited and deleted by typing its name. Tables are managed on their own page (create, reorder, delete) and defined in a form with name, description, slug, a table or grid view and a list of attributes: text, number, yes/no, date, date and time, image, reference to a record of another table, and lists and maps of one simple type, each with a description, a required switch and whether it is shown on the content page; a saved attribute's type is locked, and removing one that records hold values for asks for confirmation first. The content page of a table shows its records as a paged table (click a header to sort) or a grid of cards with a cover image, with a quick search, filter rows that fit each field (text, numbers, yes/no, dates, a chosen record, empty / not empty) and a switch for deleted records. A record has a form built from the table's attributes (a picker dialog for references, upload or import from an address for images, rows for the elements of lists and maps, errors shown beside the value they belong to), a card with every attribute, and can be deleted, restored and deleted for good
